00047 template<class ObjectType>
00048 class ObjectArrayInternal : public SmartPointer
00049 {
00050 public: 
00051     ObjectArrayInternal(const int size, const bool isNullTerminated)
00052     :   size_(size <= 0 ? 0 : size), 
00053         array(size_ == 0 ? 0 : new ObjectType[size_]),
00054         arrayIsNullTerminated(isNullTerminated),
00055         ownsTheData(true)
00056     {
00057     }
00058     
00059     ObjectArrayInternal(const int size, ObjectType *dataToUse, const bool isNullTerminated)
00060     :   size_(size <= 0 ? 0 : size), 
00061         array(size_ == 0 ? 0 : dataToUse),
00062         arrayIsNullTerminated(isNullTerminated),
00063         ownsTheData(size_ == 0 ? true : false)
00064     {
00065     }
00066     
00067     ~ObjectArrayInternal()
00068     {
00069         if(ownsTheData) 
00070             delete [] array;
00071     }
00072     
00073     inline int size() const throw() { return size_; }
00074     inline int length() const throw() 
00075     { 
00076         if(size_ == 0) 
00077             return 0;
00078         else
00079             return arrayIsNullTerminated ? size_ - 1 : size_; 
00080     }
00081     
00082     inline ObjectType* getArray() throw() { return array; }
00083     inline const ObjectType* getArray() const throw() { return array; }
00084     inline bool isNullTerminated() const throw() { return arrayIsNullTerminated; }
00085     inline void setNullTerminated(const bool state) throw() { arrayIsNullTerminated = state; } 
00086     
00087     inline void add(ObjectType const& item) throw()
00088     {
00089         const int newSize = size_ + 1;
00090         ObjectType *newArray = new ObjectType[newSize];
00091         
00092         if(arrayIsNullTerminated)
00093         {
00094             const int length = size_ - 1;
00095             
00096             newArray[size_] = array[length];
00097             newArray[length] = item;
00098             
00099             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00100             {
00101                 newArray[i] = array[i];
00102             }
00103         }
00104         else
00105         {
00106             const int length = size_;
00107             newArray[size_] = item;
00108             
00109             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00110             {
00111                 newArray[i] = array[i];
00112             }
00113         }
00114         
00115         if(ownsTheData)
00116             delete [] array;
00117         
00118         size_ = newSize;
00119         array = newArray;
00120     }
00121     
00122 private:
00123     int size_;
00124     ObjectType *array;
00125     bool arrayIsNullTerminated;
00126     bool ownsTheData;
00127 
00128     
00129     ObjectArrayInternal();
00130     ObjectArrayInternal (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00131     const ObjectArrayInternal& operator= (const ObjectArrayInternal&);
00132 };

00268     ObjectArray(ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& array0, 
00269                 ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& array1) throw()
00270     {
00271         const bool bothNullTerminated = array0.isNullTerminated() && array1.isNullTerminated();
00272         const bool eitherNullTerminated = array0.isNullTerminated() || array1.isNullTerminated();
00273         const int summedSizes = array0.size() + array1.size();
00274         const int newSize = bothNullTerminated ? summedSizes - 1 : summedSizes;
00275         
00276         if(newSize > 0)
00277         {
00278             this->setInternal(new ObjectArrayInternal<ObjectType>(newSize, eitherNullTerminated));
00279             
00280             int newIndex = 0;
00281             
00282             ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
00283             
00284             if(array != 0)
00285             {
00286                 const ObjectType *arrayPtr0 = array0.getArray();
00287                 const ObjectType *arrayPtr1 = array1.getArray();
00288                 
00289                 for(int i = 0; i < array0.length(); i++) {
00290                     array[newIndex++] = arrayPtr0[i];
00291                 }
00292                                 
00293                 for(int i = 0; i < array1.length(); i++) {
00294                     array[newIndex++] = arrayPtr1[i];
00295                 }
00296                 
00297                 if(eitherNullTerminated)
00298                     array[newIndex] = getNull();
00299             }
00300         }
00301     }

00424     ObjectArray<ObjectType> at (ObjectArray<int> const& indices) const throw()
00425     {
00426         if(this->getInternal() == 0) { return *this; }
00427

00429         const int length = indices.length();

00431         
00432         ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(size, needsNull);
00433         ObjectType* resultArray = result.getArray();
00434         const ObjectType* thisArray = this->getArray();
00435         
00436         const int thisSize = this->size();
00437         for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00438         {
00439             const int index = indices[i];
00440             resultArray[i] = index < 0 || index >= thisSize ? getNull() : thisArray[index];
00441         }
00442         
00443         if(needsNull)
00444             resultArray[length] = getNull();
00445         
00446         return result;
00447     }

00566     template<class WeightType>
00567     ObjectType& wchoose (ObjectArray<WeightType> const& weights) throw()
00568     {
00569         if(this->getInternal() == 0 || this->size() == 0) 
00570         {
00571             return getNull();
00572         }
00573         else 
00574         {
00575             const int length = this->length();
00576             ObjectArray<WeightType> thresholds = ObjectArray<WeightType>(length, false);
00577             
00578             WeightType sum = 0;
00579             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00580             {
00581                 sum += weights.wrapAt(i);
00582                 thresholds[i] = sum;
00583             }
00584             
00585             WeightType random = rand(sum);
00586             
00587             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00588             {
00589                 if(random < thresholds[i])
00590                     return this->getArray()[i];
00591             }
00592             
00593             return this->getArray()[length-1];
00594         }
00595     }

00697     bool contains (ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& itemsToSearchFor) const throw()
00698     {
00699         const ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
00700         const ObjectType *items = itemsToSearchFor.getArray();
00701         
00702         if(array != 0 && items != 0)
00703         {
00704             const int length = this->length();
00705             int itemsToFind = itemsToSearchFor.length();
00706             
00707             if(length == 0 || itemsToFind == 0)
00708                 return false;
00709             
00710             int nextIndexToFind = 0;
00711             
00712             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00713             {
00714                 if(array[i] == items[nextIndexToFind])
00715                 {
00716                     itemsToFind--;
00717                     
00718                     while(itemsToFind > 0)
00719                     {
00720                         i++;
00721                         nextIndexToFind++;
00722                         
00723                         if((i > length) || (array[i] != items[nextIndexToFind]))
00724                             return false;
00725                         
00726                         itemsToFind--;
00727                     }
00728                     
00729                     return true;
00730                 }
00731             }
00732         }       
00733         
00734         return false;
00735     }
00736         
00737     int indexOf (ObjectType const& itemToSearchFor, const int startIndex = 0) const throw()
00738     {
00739         const ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
00740         
00741         if(array != 0)
00742         {
00743             const int size = this->size();
00744             for(int i = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex; i < size; i++)
00745             {
00746                 if(array[i] == itemToSearchFor)
00747                     return i;
00748             }
00749         }       
00750         
00751         return -1;
00752     }
00753     
00755     int indexOf (ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& itemsToSearchFor, const int startIndex = 0) const throw()
00756     {
00757         const ObjectType *array = this->getArray();
00758         const ObjectType *items = itemsToSearchFor.getArray();
00759 
00760         if(array != 0 && items != 0)
00761         {
00762             const int length = this->length();
00763             int itemsToFind = itemsToSearchFor.length();
00764             
00765             if(length == 0 || itemsToFind == 0)
00766                 return -1;
00767             
00768             int nextIndexToFind = 0;
00769             
00770             for(int i = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex; i < length; i++)
00771             {
00772                 if(array[i] == items[nextIndexToFind])
00773                 {
00774                     int foundAtIndex = i;
00775                     
00776                     itemsToFind--;
00777                     
00778                     while(itemsToFind > 0)
00779                     {
00780                         i++;
00781                         nextIndexToFind++;
00782                         
00783                         if((i > length) || (array[i] != items[nextIndexToFind]))
00784                             return -1;
00785                         
00786                         itemsToFind--;
00787                     }
00788                     
00789                     return foundAtIndex;
00790                 }
00791             }
00792         }       
00793         
00794         return -1;
00795     }
00796     
00798     int indexOfAny (ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& itemsToSearchFor, const int startIndex = 0) const throw()
00799     {
00800         const ObjectType *array = this->getArray();

00802         if(array != 0)
00803         {
00804             const int length = this->length();
00805             const int itemsToFind = itemsToSearchFor.length();
00806             
00807             if(length == 0 || itemsToFind == 0)
00808                 return -1;
00809             
00810             for(int i = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex; i < length; i++)
00811             {
00812                 if(itemsToSearchFor.contains(array[i]))
00813                     return i;
00814             }
00815         }
00816         
00817         return -1;
00818     }

00834     
00835     ObjectArray<ObjectType> range(const int startIndex, const int endIndex) const throw()
00836     {
00837         const int size = this->size();
00838         if(size == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00839         
00840         const int startIndexChecked = startIndex < 0 ? 0 : startIndex;
00841         const int endIndexChecked = endIndex > size ? size : endIndex;
00842 
00843         if(startIndexChecked >= endIndexChecked) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00844         
00845         const ObjectType *sourceArray = this->getArray();
00846         if(sourceArray == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00847         
00848         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00849         
00850         const int diff = endIndexChecked - startIndexChecked;
00851         const int newSize = needsNull && (endIndexChecked < size) ? diff + 1 : diff;
00852                 
00853         ObjectArray<ObjectType> result(newSize, needsNull);
00854         ObjectType *resultArray = result.getArray();
00855         
00856         int resultIndex = 0;
00857         for(int sourceIndex = startIndexChecked; sourceIndex < endIndexChecked; sourceIndex++)
00858         {
00859             resultArray[resultIndex++] = sourceArray[sourceIndex];
00860         }       
00861         
00862         if(needsNull)
00863             resultArray[resultIndex] = this->getNull();
00864         
00865         return result;
00866     }
00867     
00868     ObjectArray<ObjectType> replace(ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& find, ObjectArray<ObjectType> const& substitute) const throw()
00869     {
00870         const int size = this->size();
00871         const int findLength = find.length();
00872         int startIndex = 0;
00873         int findIndex;
00874         
00875         ObjectArray<ObjectType> result;
00876         
00877         while((findIndex = this->indexOf(find, startIndex)) >= 0)
00878         {
00879             result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
00880             result <<= substitute;
00881             startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
00882         }
00883         
00884         result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
00885         
00886         return result;
00887     }

00902             }

00927     
00928     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > group(const int groupSize) const throw()
00929     {
00930         const int length = this->length();
00931         if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00932         
00933         const int groupSizeChecked = groupSize < 1 ? 1 : groupSize;
00934         const int groupSizeMinus1 = groupSizeChecked-1;
00935         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00936         
00937         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
00938         ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
00939         
00940         const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
00941         
00942         for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00943         {
00944             element <<= thisArray[i];
00945             if((i % groupSizeChecked) == groupSizeMinus1)
00946             {
00947                 if(needsNull) 
00948                 {
00949                     element <<= this->getNull();
00950                     element.setNullTerminated(true);
00951                 }
00952                 
00953                 result <<= element;
00954                 element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00955             }
00956         }
00957         
00958         if(element.length() != 0)
00959         {
00960             if(needsNull) 
00961             {
00962                 element <<= this->getNull();
00963                 element.setNullTerminated(true);
00964             }
00965             
00966             result <<= element;
00967         }
00968         
00969         return result;
00970     }
00971     
00972     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > split(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimiters) const throw()
00973     {
00974         const int length = this->length();
00975         if(length == 0) return ObjectArray<ObjectType>();
00976         
00977         const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();
00978         
00979         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
00980         ObjectArray<ObjectType> element;
00981         
00982         const ObjectType *thisArray = this->getArray();
00983         if(thisArray != 0)
00984         {
00985             for(int i = 0; i < length; i++)
00986             {
00987                 const ObjectType item = thisArray[i];
00988                 
00989                 if(delimiters.contains(item))
00990                 {
00991                     if(element.length() > 0)
00992                     {
00993                         if(needsNull) 
00994                         {
00995                             element <<= this->getNull();
00996                             element.setNullTerminated(true);
00997                         }
00998                         
00999                         result <<= element;
01000                         element = ObjectArray<ObjectType>();    
01001                     }
01002                 }
01003                 else
01004                 {
01005                     element <<= item;
01006                 }
01007             }
01008             
01009             if(element.length() != 0)
01010             {
01011                 if(needsNull) 
01012                 {
01013                     element <<= this->getNull();
01014                     element.setNullTerminated(true);
01015                 }
01016                 
01017                 result <<= element;
01018             }
01019         }
01020         
01021         return result;      
01022     }
01023     
01024     ObjectArray<ObjectArray<ObjectType> > splitSequence(ObjectArray<ObjectType> delimitingSequence) const throw()
01025     {
01026         const int size = this->size();
01027         ObjectArray< ObjectArray<ObjectType> > result;
01028         
01029         if(size != 0)
01030         {
01031             const int findLength = delimitingSequence.length();
01032             int startIndex = 0;
01033             int findIndex;
01034             
01035             while((findIndex = this->indexOf(delimitingSequence, startIndex)) >= 0)
01036             {
01037                 result <<= this->range(startIndex, findIndex);
01038                 startIndex = findIndex + findLength;
01039             }
01040             
01041             result <<= this->range(startIndex, size);
01042         }
01043         
01044         return result;      
01045     }
01046

01056 // these following macors need to take into account that arrays might be null terminated!
01057 #define NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon                                                              \
01058             const unsigned int leftSize = this->size();                                                     \
01059             if(leftSize == 0) return rightOperand;                                                          \
01060             const unsigned int rightSize = rightOperand.size();                                             \
01061             if(rightSize == 0) return *this;                                                                \
01062             const bool eitherNullTerminated = this->isNullTerminated() || rightOperand.isNullTerminated();  \
01063             const unsigned int leftLength = this->length();                                                 \
01064             const unsigned int rightLength = rightOperand.length();                                         \
01065             const int newLength = leftLength > rightLength ? leftLength : rightLength;                      \
01066             const int newSize = leftSize > rightSize ? leftSize : rightSize;                                \
01067             const NumericalType *leftArray = this->getArray();                                      \
01068             const NumericalType *rightArray = rightOperand.getArray()
01069 
01070 
01071 #define NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBody(OPERATOR)                                                          \
01072             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
01073             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
01074             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
01075             if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                            \
01076                                                                                                             \
01077             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
01078                 resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];            \
01079             }                                                                                               \
01080             return result
01081 
01082 #define NumericalArrayBinaryComparisonOperatorBody(OPERATOR)                                                \
01083             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
01084             NumericalArray<bool> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), false);                         \
01085             bool *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                          \
01086                                                                                                             \
01087             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
01088                 resultArray[i] = leftArray[i % leftLength] OPERATOR rightArray[i % rightLength];            \
01089             }                                                                                               \
01090             return result
01091 
01092 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)                                                          \
01093             NumericalArrayBinaryOperatorBodyCommon;                                                         \
01094             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), eitherNullTerminated); \
01095             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
01096             if(eitherNullTerminated) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                            \
01097                                                                                                             \
01098             for(unsigned int i = 0; i < newLength; i++) {                                                   \
01099                 resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)(leftArray[i % leftLength]),                              \
01100                                           (double)(rightArray[i % rightLength]));                           \
01101             }                                                                                               \
01102             return result
01103 
01104 #define NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)                                                                    \
01105             NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION (NumericalArray<NumericalType> const& rightOperand) const throw()        \
01106             {                                                                                                               \
01107                 NumericalArrayBinaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);                                                           \
01108             }
01109 
01110 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(FUNCTION)                                                           \
01111             const int newSize = this->size();                                                               \
01112             const int newLength = this->length();                                                           \
01113             if(newSize == 0) return *this;                                                                  \
01114             const bool needsNull = this->isNullTerminated();                                                \
01115             NumericalArray<NumericalType> result(NumericalArraySpec(newSize, false), needsNull);            \
01116             const NumericalType *thisArray = this->getArray();                                      \
01117             NumericalType *resultArray = result.getArray();                                                 \
01118                                                                                                             \
01119             for(int i = 0; i < newSize; i++)                                                                \
01120                 resultArray[i] = FUNCTION((double)thisArray[i]);                                            \
01121                                                                                                             \
01122             if(needsNull) resultArray[newLength] = 0;                                                       \
01123             return result
01124 
01125 #define NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionDefinition(FUNCTION)                                                     \
01126             NumericalArray<NumericalType> FUNCTION () const throw()                                         \
01127             {                                                                                               \
01128                 NumericalArrayUnaryFunctionBody(ugen::FUNCTION);                                            \
01129             }

01268     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> line(const int size, const NumericalType start, const NumericalType end) throw()
01269     {
01270         ugen_assert(size >= 2);
01271         
01272         const int numValues = size < 2 ? 2 : size;
01273         
01274         NumericalArray<NumericalType> newArray = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::withSize(numValues);
01275         
01276         double inc = double(end - start) / (numValues - 1);
01277         double currentValue = start;
01278         NumericalType *outputValues = newArray.getArray();
01279         
01280         for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01281         {
01282             roundCopy(currentValue, outputValues[i]);
01283             currentValue += inc;
01284         }
01285         
01286         return newArray;
01287     }

01298         
01299         NumericalType currentValue = start;

01301         
01302         for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01303         {
01304             outputValues[i] = currentValue;

01335     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> rand(const int size, 
01336                                               const NumericalType lower, 
01337                                               const NumericalType upper) throw()
01338     {
01339         ugen_assert(size > 0);
01340         
01341         const int numValues = size < 1 ? 1 : size;
01342         
01343         NumericalArray<NumericalType> newArray = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::withSize(numValues);
01344         NumericalType *outputValues = newArray.getArray();
01345         NumericalType diff = upper-lower;
01346         NumericalType randFactor = (NumericalType)1 / (NumericalType)RAND_MAX;
01347         
01348         for(int i = 0; i < numValues; i++)
01349         {
01350             NumericalType randomValue = rand() * randFactor;
01351             
01352             //outputValues[i] = Ran088::defaultGenerator().next(lower, upper);
01353             outputValues[i] = randomValue * diff + lower;
01354         }
01355         
01356         return newArray;
01357     }

01422                                                       const float repeats = 1.f, 
01423                                                       const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01424     {
01425         ugen_assert(repeats > 0.f);
01426         return NumericalArray<double>::line(size, 0.0, pi * repeats).sin() * peak;
01427     }
01428     
01429     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> triangleWindow(const int size, 
01430                                                         const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01431     {
01432         NumericalArray<NumericalType> bartlett = NumericalArray<NumericalType>::bartlettWindow(size+2, peak);
01433         return bartlett.range(1, size+1);
01434     }
01435     
01436     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> bartlettWindow(const int size, 
01437                                                         const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01438     {
01439         return -NumericalArray<NumericalType>::line(size, -peak, peak).abs() + NumericalArray<NumericalType>(peak);
01440     }
01441     
01442     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> hannWindow(const int size, 
01443                                                     const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01444     {
01445         return (-NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size) + 1.f) * 0.5f * peak;
01446     }
01447     
01448     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> hammingWindow(const int size, 
01449                                                        const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01450     {
01451         return (-NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size) * 0.46f + 0.54f) * peak;
01452     }
01453     
01454     static NumericalArray<NumericalType> blackmanWindow(const int size, 
01455                                                         const float alpha = 0.16f, 
01456                                                         const NumericalType peak = 1) throw()
01457     {
01458         float a0 = (1.f-alpha) * 0.5f;
01459         float a1 = 0.5f;
01460         float a2 = alpha * 0.5f;
01461         
01462         return (-NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size) * a1 + NumericalArray<double>::cosineTable(size, 2.f) * a2 + a0) * peak;
01463     }

02295         {
02296             int c = this->atUnchecked(i).ObjectArray<ArrayType>::indexOf(item, column);

02306         column = -1;

02310     {
02311         const int numRows = this->length();
02312         if(numRows < 2) return false;
02313         
02314         int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02315         if(numColumns < 2) return false;
02316         
02317         int prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02318         for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02319         {
02320             numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02321             if(numColumns != prevNumColumns)
02322                 return false;
02323             
02324             prevNumColumns = numColumns;
02325         }
02326         
02327         return true;
02328     }

02339         
02340         int numColumns = this->atUnchecked(0).length();
02341         
02342         int maxNumColumns = numColumns;
02343         for(int row = 1; row < numRows; row++)
02344         {
02345             numColumns = this->atUnchecked(row).length();
02346             if(numColumns > maxNumColumns)
02347                 maxNumColumns = numColumns;
